exposure: very low plasma PlGF levels (<12 pg/ml)
Uterine artery Doppler velocimetry (UADV) pulsatility index (PI)
cohort: 73 pregnancies between 19 and 35 weeks gestation: 57 pregnancies at risk of PE and 16 at diagnosis of IUGR
finding: PlGF may provide useful information to identify fetuses requiring increased surveillance and possibly urgent delivery in pregnancies at risk of adverse outcomes.
